source_metadata.question: In trapezium $P Q R S, \angle R S P=2 \times \angle S P Q$ and $\angle S P Q=2 \times \angle P Q R$. Also $\angle Q R S=k \times \angle P Q R$. What is the value of $k$ ? <image1>
